content.text: shin xilloti gaammo mela yayyonna de7oosona.
Issi kawotethay makalliko, haareysati daroosona;
shin kaaletheysi cincanne akeekancho gidiko,
sarotethinne wopi de7ees.
Manqota un7ethiya kawoy
kathi dhaysiya wolqaama ira mela.
Higge bonchona asi iita asaa sabbees;
shin higge bonchiya asi iita asaa ixees.
Iita asatas suure pirdi gelenna;
shin Godaa goyinniya asi ubbaa akeekes.
suure asi gididi manqo gideysi lo77o.
shin pathonna asara hemetey ba aawa yeellayees.

content: Mishe yelon tal7eynne ase bonqidi duretiya asi

content.text: he aquwa manqotas keehiya asas shiishees.
Higge si7anaape gidi ba haytha tucciya,
uraa woosay Godaa sinthan ixetidaba.
Suureta iita ogen kaalethiya uray
ba bookida ollan kundana;
shin geeshshati lo77oba laattana.
Dure asi bana cinca gidi qopees;
shin akeeki de7iya manqoy iya paacees.
Xilloti xooniya wode asa ubbay ufaytees;
shin iitati maata oykiya wode asay qosetees.
Ba nagaraa genthiya asi aacenna;
shin paaxeynne nagara aggey maarota ekana.
Godaa ubba wode yayiya asi anjetidaysa;
shin ba wozana minthiya asi meton gelana.
Manqo asaa haariya iita halaqay,
gudiya gaammonne koshatida babantha mela.
Akeeki bayna kawoy ba deriya qohees;
shin ase qohonna halaqi daro laythi haarana.
Ase wodhiya asi hayqana gakanaw baqatishe de7ees;
iya oonika maaddenna.
Borey bayna hemetiya asi qohetenna;
shin geella asi akeekona kundana.
Minnidi oothiya asi kathi kallees;
shin pathonna amo kaalliya asi manqotethi laattana.
Ammanetiya uray daro anjetana;
shin duretanaw woxiya asi meto be7ana.
Som7o be7idi pirdoy lo77o gidenna;
shin asi baso uytha gisho gidi qohees.
Yaare asi duretanaw baqetees;
manqotethi akeekona oykanaysa erenna.
Ase coo sabbiya asape
hanqetiya asi guyepe galatetees.
Ba aawanne ba aayiw kaysotidi, “Nagara oothabike”
giya asinne demmidaba dhaysiya asi issino.
Uuze asi ooshshi denthees;
shin Godan ammanetiya asi kallees.
Banan ammanetiya asi eeya;
shin cincatethan hemetiya asi saro de7ees.
Manqos immiya asi metootenna;
shin enta be7anaape gidi qilim7ey baadetana.
Iita asati shuumetiya wode asay qosetees;
shin enti dhayiya wode xilloti daroosona.
